camel_example: aliyun esa SetHttpDDoSAttackIntelligentProtection --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --AiMode defense --AiTemplate level60
description_en: Configures HTTP DDoS deep learning and protection settings
description_zh: 该接口用于设置HTTP DDoS深度学习和防护配置信息
name: SetHttpDDoSAttackIntelligentProtection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP DDoS depth learning and defense pattern. Valid values:
observe: Monitor.
defense: Block
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP DDoS深度学习和防护模式。取值：
observe：观察
defense：拦截
parameters.name: ai_mode

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP DDoS deep learning and protection level. Valid values:
level0: Very loose.
level30: Loose.
level60: Normal.
level90: Strict
parameters.help_zh:
HTTP DDoS深度学习和防护等级。取值：
level0：非常宽松
level30：宽松
level60：正常
level90：严格
parameters.name: ai_template

AiMode.description_en:
The HTTP DDoS intelligent protection pattern. Valid values:
observe: Warning.
defense: Defense
AiMode.description_zh:
HTTP DDoS智能防护模式。取值：
observe：预警
defense：防护

AiTemplate.description_en:
The HTTP DDoS intelligent protection level. Valid values:
level0: Very loose.
level30: Loose.
level60: Normal.
level90: Strict
AiTemplate.description_zh:
HTTP DDoS智能防护等级。取值：
level0：非常宽松
level30：宽松
level60：正常
level90：严格
